title: User plugin file (*.replays-plugin.json)
description: The shareable form of a user plugin: the manifest and the JavaScript source, optionally with its saved versions. Importing a file loads it as a draft; nothing is stored until the person approves. A manifest may carry `targets` (the core and distribution versions it was kept under, see plugin-manifest.schema.json); an imported file's `targets` is informational and is replaced when the importer keeps it. Source of truth: src/shared/malleable.ts.

source.description: JavaScript that calls replays.tab / replays.panel / replays.action. See docs/malleability.md for the sandbox API.
